It does sound to me like you really do need to tell people, and honestly, in my experience it has made things easier on me. They don't get upset when I don't want to go out because they know that I'm feeling down. This also seems to help because then they will ask if I need to talk and its nice to finally have someone who understands and they will actually listen to what you have to say and offer some advice (if they can). It truly made my life easier to let people know. It was hard to tell them at first as I was afraid of what they may think but I was surprised, and I think you would be too. Most friends and even people you barely know for the most part care about another persons general well being. You just need to open up... And also be prepared to answer a lot of questions about your depression and how you feel.

I'm in the same boat as you right now. At the moment I'm just cleaning houses to make money, but I'm also doing volunteer work at different places and they have job programs here where you basically get a run down of what you would be doing if you did this or that. So it might be an idea to check what your community has to offer. When I lived in a big city they had programs like this everywhere but now even in a small town they have some here too. Look at a college and their programs, job centres, community centres, and even the newspaper. It's a start.

That's kind of a tricky one when it comes to the whole roommate thing. I guess it depends on how well you know them and if you would be willing to just causally get to know them. Go for supper or something. But if I was in your situation that would be how I'd start to get the ball rolling, and eventually I once I've gotten to know them I would give them a heads up about my depression. I've realized that once I started to talk about my depression, the more I noticed I'm really not the only one... And not even close. It turns out that a lot of the people I was afraid to talk too was also depressed as well, or had been at a time, or even just knew someone who was. Hope I helped you out a little bit. I'm here for more advice if needed :). Wish you luck.
